notes.title: Details of the February 22, 2022 update:
notes.content:
Fixes in compatibility of resolutions other than 9/16.
Fix the score bug.
Corrections and adjustments to HUDs.
Improvements to the initial tutorial.
Several improvements in gameplay in general.

We apologize to those who had difficulty enjoying the game, we are working to improve more and more, thank you very much for playing our first game!
Sincerely, DHDevStudios!
